product_metadata.title: Pacific Giftware Pomeranian Dog Salt and Pepper Shakers Set, Magnetic
features: Bringing the fun back into functionality with functional yet attractive design
Made of high quality and food safe ceramic, comes nicely packaged in gift box
Great gift item for any occasion, especially Pomeranian lovers
Perfect decorative accessory for any kitchen countertop or dining table setting
Hand washing recommended, not microwave safe
description: Looking for a gift idea for any occasion for a Pomeranian lover? You won’t be disappointed by this fun and attractive looking Pomeranian magnetic salt and pepper shaker set s/p. Each shaker comes with an embedded magnet that keeps both pieces together until they need to be separated to season a particular dish. Introduce some fun into functionality in your kitchen or dining decor.
